original_benchmark.notes: Original release ships queries and rubrics plus an LLM-judge grader; responses come from any external system. Judge panel: claude-sonnet-4-6, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gpt-5.4.

harbor_adapter.parity_costs: ~$22.30 for parity and its checks; ~$26.66 including the large-task judge check
harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on the 11-task --split parity subset (5%, stratified by use case), 3 runs per side, graded on both sides by the unmodified upstream grader with upstream's judge panel (claude-sonnet-4-6, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gpt-5.4). Oracle reports are constructed from rubrics; byte-identical oracle reports skip the judges.
